headline: TidyBot's chores collapse to one tap
lede: Slot a shipped tap-to-act (#2537, squash 24869f7): every tap now carries its verb — walk, open, place, or pull the named stow — with mismatched carries refusing instead of a blind WRONG STOW. 135 gates green, a new mutant dies by name, and the law rides the merged pad so replays and determinism never noticed. Meanwhile slot b landed the SMASH TV BFS router and Britannia's town walls closed the gap another lane was probing. TidyBot's honest-gaps list is now empty.

notes.text: #2537 TidyBot tap-to-act: pure tapAct judges place/open/aimed-retrieve/default-retrieve; orders park as pending chores and fire as synthesized pad presses; places at shut bodies chain OPEN→PLACE, refusals back off 20 ticks, cancel law mirrors glide+mark. Node gates 88→109; mutant tapact kills 4 named gates; contract 15/15; verified live on jalfern.com.

Playwright precedence trap cost 30 min: `await page.evaluate(f).prop` reads .prop off the PROMISE — always undefined. A correct game looked broken. Bind the value first and put the got-value in the gate name so flakes self-report.
`npm run dev … | head -N` kills the dev server when head exits — the port then looks taken-but-dead. Redirect to a log file.

Britannia .ULT decode: region boards are not raw tile maps (mixed terrain + junk); region name table sits in AVATAR.EXE ~63871 before a 13-value numeric table, position map unresolved — but #2538 shipped town walls, so the gap is closed without the decode. Don't re-probe.
